dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Hey Michael, I just discovered that I get paid more than my colleague, even though she's a native English speaker. Just because she looks Indian despite being born in Canada.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: That's not công bằng. But unfortunately, this discrimination is quite common in Asia. Người often think that English giáo viên must have a Western appearance.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: That's true, but this makes me feel guilty. I'm not better than her, I just have whiter skin. What should I làm now?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: You could talk to the manager about this issue. Or share some of your lương with her. But it's difficult to change social prejudices.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Share my lương? Do you nghĩ it's that simple? I need money to live too! But... I can't just do nothing. Maybe I should find a way to help her advance.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I understand. But I admire your sense of công bằng. Not many người would care about this issue. Hey, have you ever nghĩ about fighting together for công bằng in education?
